Contact the University of St Andrews

The University's hours of operation are Monday to Friday, 8.30am to 5pm.

If you call out of hours, you will be transferred to a security officer who will take your details. An appropriate member of staff will then call you back to offer further assistance.

Emergencies

In the case of an emergency, call 999 (or 9-999 from a University phone) to contact emergency services.

Non-emergencies

If you are concerned about the wellbeing of a student or non-life-threatening issues, call +44 (0)1334 46 2720 to contact Student Services.

Please be aware of the University's confidentiality code regarding student privacy.

For non-emergencies regarding buildings and estates on University property, call +44 (0)1334 46 3999 to contact Estates maintenance and repairs.
